title: I Turned the Cabin Log Into Three Evenings of Truth

parts.text: I hung my key and saw a second green rubber head already waiting. I am twenty-six, designer, reset weekend, wet-dog condo smell in a woods A-frame. The binder log said E.M. yesterday at 4:10, extra towels. We arrived today. Evan Miles. Berry lipstick on two glasses. Mint ChapStick on me. Evan said, "The company sent me early" I said, "The log says extra towels" He called it a surprise setup. I can still name the ugly little detail, which is how I know it happened. I noticed a scuff on the floor shaped like a comma, which fit i. Someone had left a receipt in the cup holder, faded blue ink. The air tasted like leftover rain and cleaning spray, which fit i. A cheap clock on the wall jumped a minute late, then caught up. I kept my keys in my left pocket so I would not fidget, which fit i. The plastic chair stuck to my legs when I shifted. A vending machine hummed in another room like a bored insect, which fit i. I counted three ceiling tiles with water stains before I spoke again. My socks had a hole I had been ignoring since Tuesday, which fit i. The door closer hissed the way office doors always hiss.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: A car I do not know is coming up the gravel, and he just called my photos war.

parts.text: Tasha got out with berry lipstick and a spare lanyard key. She thought I came Sunday. It was Saturday. Evan tried office-towels fiction. I packed. I left ChapStick on the binder. The six-hour drive was a podcast I did not hear. Monday I emailed the rental company about alibi logs, not about Tasha's face. They refunded. I called a locksmith for my apartment because theater is contagious. Tasha said, "I don't work for the office" Evan said, "Don't" The wet-dog jacket smell followed me in memory only. parts.text: I answered Evan once about the too-sweet coffee. He denied in a confirming rhythm. I told couple-friends with the log photo, not the lipstick. Two people admitted cologne suspicions. I bought a mug that does not match the registry. I still design at the kitchen table. 4:10 sticky notes are a stupid ritual I am allowed. Tasha is not my villain. The log is the witness. I do not wish them a cabin. I wish myself keys that only hang in ones. Friend said, "You okay" I said, "I have a log and a locksmith" The locksmith hummed. The new key was ugly and mine.
